name: symbol_overlay_regs
desc: Symbols (boxes, circles, crosshairs) and texts drawn over a video stream; every change applies at the next frame start after COMMIT.

params.name: NOBJ
params.desc: objects (1..32: 0-15 in the first bank, 16-31 in the second)

registers.name: CTRL
registers.desc: [0] enable (taken at every frame start), [2:1] LABEL_SCALE (taken with a COMMIT, as FONT): object labels drawn at 1 << LABEL_SCALE times the 3 x 5 font's cell (0 = 1x), [3] FONT: labels and texts at 2x, 4x, 8x in the smooth font (DejaVu Sans Mono Bold, 4-bit coverage blended with the video; src/include/overlay_font_aa_s<S>.mem from scripts/make_aa_font.py) instead of the enlarged 3 x 5 font (1x is always the 3 x 5 font)

registers.name: COMMIT
registers.desc: write 1: the object and text registers apply at the next frame start; reads [0] commit pending

registers.name: FRAME_NUM
registers.desc: write: the number (5 BCD digits) the next frame shows, then one more per frame; read: the last frame's

fields.name: SHAPE
fields.desc: 0 rectangle outline, 1 filled, 2 crosshair, 3 circle (round the box centre, diameter the larger side)

fields.name: OVAL
fields.desc: shape 3: an oval (ellipse) inside the box instead of the circle

fields.name: TICKS
fields.desc: rectangle: a 2-pixel tick at the middle of each side, pointing to the centre

fields.name: TRIANGLE
fields.desc: an upward triangle inscribed in the box (any SHAPE): dashed edges with DASHED, the vertices solid

fields.name: CORNERS
fields.desc: dashed rectangle: the corners (a quarter of the shorter side, at least 3 pixels) solid

registers.name: OBJ_COLOR
registers.desc: object i colour, pixel as on the stream ([7:0] R [15:8] G [23:16] B)

fields.name: BACKDROP
fields.desc: darken the video under the text

fields.name: FNUM
fields.desc: the frame number after the characters

registers.name: TXT_POS
registers.desc: text j top-left corner: [15:0] x [31:16] y

registers.name: TXT_COLOR
registers.desc: text j colour, pixel as on the stream

registers.name: TXT_CHARS
registers.desc: characters: word 4 j + q of text j holds characters 4 q .. 4 q + 3 (ASCII, character 4 q in [7:0])

registers.name: OBJ_LABEL
registers.desc: object i label: up to 4 ASCII characters (character 0 in [7:0], 0 ends it), drawn at 1 << CTRL.LABEL_SCALE times the font, centred below the symbol (above it when it would cross the bottom of the frame) on a darkened backdrop

registers.name: OBJ2_CTRL
registers.desc: second bank: object 16 + i, as OBJ_CTRL (NOBJ above 16)

fields.name: SHAPE
fields.desc: 0 rectangle outline, 1 filled, 2 crosshair, 3 circle (round the box centre, diameter the larger side)

fields.name: OVAL
fields.desc: shape 3: an oval (ellipse) inside the box instead of the circle

fields.name: TICKS
fields.desc: rectangle: a 2-pixel tick at the middle of each side, pointing to the centre

fields.name: TRIANGLE
fields.desc: an upward triangle inscribed in the box (any SHAPE): dashed edges with DASHED, the vertices solid

fields.name: CORNERS
fields.desc: dashed rectangle: the corners (a quarter of the shorter side, at least 3 pixels) solid

registers.name: OBJ2_X
registers.desc: second bank: object 16 + i, as OBJ_X (NOBJ above 16)

registers.name: OBJ2_Y
registers.desc: second bank: object 16 + i, as OBJ_Y (NOBJ above 16)

registers.name: OBJ2_COLOR
registers.desc: second bank: object 16 + i, as OBJ_COLOR (NOBJ above 16)

registers.name: OBJ2_LABEL
registers.desc: second bank: label of object 16 + i, as OBJ_LABEL (NOBJ above 16)
